name: oxDNA
summary: Coarse-grained simulation of DNA and RNA systems.

steps: Read the maintainer's oxDNA source-build guide and decide whether CPU-only, CUDA, MPI, or Python bindings are needed.
Check CMake, compiler and optional CUDA compatibility. Build in a separate user-owned directory and do not run make install against the system Python.
Confirm that the oxDNA, DNAnalysis and confGenerator executables appear in the documented build/bin location before running any simulation.
install.verify_note: Inspect the built executables and run a maintainer-supplied minimal example separately after the user approves compute use.

notes: The optional oxpy/analysis-tools route has its own Python-version requirements; GPU and MPI builds need separate validation.
